statement: The sharp maximum number of real smooth plane cubics through seven general real points and tangent to two general real lines is 16.
scope: Smooth irreducible degree-three plane curves through seven general real points and tangent to two general real lines.
notes:
Here k denotes the number of tangent-line conditions. Other k are not settled by these cited statements.

Total reality holds with one or two line tangencies: the sharp maxima are 4 and 16, respectively.

The one-line-tangency result formerly included here is now recorded separately. Felice Ronga, A real Riemann-Hurwitz theorem (2000, ronga_2000_real_riemann_hurwitz).
